detail.longDescription:
We avoid chores at home, then pay money to do them in games. So what makes washing a virtual driveway so satisfying while the real dishes keep waiting in the sink? Let's talk about PowerWash Simulator, Hozy, Don't Starve Together, daily quests and one very hard-working robot.
